source_name: Pla ALFA — daily fire-risk level (Agents Rurals)
text: Pla ALFA reaches level 4 on route comarques tomorrow, including level 4 in Segarra, Segrià. Municipalities at level 3+: Almatret (Segrià, level 4), la Granja d'Escarp (Segrià, level 4), Sanaüja (Segarra, level 4), Seròs (Segrià, level 4), Torrefeta i Florejacs (Segarra, level 4), Agramunt (Urgell, level 3), Aguilar de Segarra (Bages, level 3), Aitona (Segrià, level 3). Level 4 is the only level that can restrict access on foot to protected natural areas and heavily-frequented forest, and it is discretionary — applied by signed resolution — so a level 4 does not by itself mean a stage is shut. Check the closures list, which is authoritative for that.

Pla ALFA currently closes 7 natural space(s) in Catalonia, none on the route: Montmell-Marmellar, Prades, Montsant, Montsec de Rubies, Montsec d'Ares, Baronia de Rialb, Ribera_salada. Recorded as a base rate for how often access closures are invoked.
